item.title: The PATHWAYS is debate is too important to be left to specialists
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor Chris Whitty is wrong to argue that debate on the PATHWAYS trial of puberty blockers in children should be left to specialists. The trial raises deep and important questions: What is it to be male or female? What are the proper limits of medicine? Is it acceptable to treat mental distress by altering healthy bodies? item.title: Re: Roger James Wolstenholme
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, Thank you for publishing your obituary of Dr. Roger Wolstenholme. I was very saddened to hear the news of his death. item.title: Re: The growing threat of domestic wood burning stoves—and industry’s legal attempts to shut down clean air campaigns
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, We read with interest the recent BMJ investigation which highlights the health harm caused by wood burning in urban stoves[1]. Such burning also contributes to climate change. Emissions related to logging, sawmill activity, transport and (often) kiln drying can be substantial [2]. item.title: Delirium ICU
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor Delirium, the acute confusional syndrome, is a common although infradiagnosed problem in the critically ill patient, especially the hypoactive sub- type. Risk factors for delirium are previous cognitive disturbances, some comorbidities, ambiental factors and the acute organic alterations of critical illness. item.title: The Sstructure of the Mind

item.title: Tetris and PTSD symptoms: a medical perspective on benefits, limits, and escalation
